text.name: Human Resources
text.tagline: Unified employee data from hire to retire
text.description: The Cyber ERP Human Resources module keeps organizational structure, personnel records, employment and pay orders, time and attendance, and leave and missions in one connected system. Configurable formulas and calculation tables align payroll with your organization's regulations and pay factors. Recruitment, training, performance evaluation, and welfare features also help track employee status and support workforce planning.
benefits: Eliminate duplicate entry of employee data
Align personnel administration, time and attendance, and payroll
Calculate pay based on defined formulas and factors
Track training, evaluations, and welfare services
Access employee records for personnel decisions

text.name: Formula and Table Management
text.cardText: Build formulas and calculation tables with validation, test runs, and edit history.
text.tagline: Define and control HR calculation rules
text.description: The Formula and Table Management system provides HR parameters, mathematical functions, and multi-input tables for defining calculations. Validating a formula and test-running it for a single employee helps keep calculations under control. Recording the date, reason, editor, and supporting documents for each change makes calculation rule changes traceable.
benefits: Track the history of calculation changes

text.name: Organizational Structure
text.cardText: Maintain companies, organizational units, jobs, positions, and job descriptions in a connected structure.
text.tagline: Define your structure, jobs, and organizational capacity
text.description: The Organizational Structure system links the structure of companies and units with jobs and organizational positions. Job descriptions and documents with validity periods are stored to support structure management. Viewing the capacity and occupancy status of jobs and positions supports planning and the issuance of personnel orders.
benefits: Maintain valid job descriptions and documents
Align organizational structure with personnel data

text.name: Personnel Records
text.cardText: Record employees' personal details, work and education history, skills, and bank accounts.
text.tagline: A unified file of employee information and history
text.description: The Personnel Records system keeps employees' personal information and history in a shared file. Recording education, training, skills, and other details, along with viewing employment orders and payslips, makes each person's history easy to access. Integration with training and personnel administration, plus custom factors, puts employee data to work across HR processes.
benefits: Record custom data that affects calculations

text.name: Personnel Administration
text.cardText: Define employment types and issue individual and group orders with related pay and work factors.
text.tagline: Manage employee employment and pay orders
text.description: The Personnel Administration system links employment types and pay and work factors to employee orders. Specifying the job, position, organizational unit, cost centers, and projects in the employment order, and recording the effective date of pay orders, establishes the basis for calculations. Group order issuance and checks on capacity and job-position relationships make personnel changes easier to manage.
benefits: Apply pay changes by effective date
Allocate employee costs to cost centers and projects

text.name: Time and Attendance
text.cardText: Record clock-ins and clock-outs and calculate attendance, overtime, lateness, and absence based on shift rules.
text.tagline: Calculate work time based on shifts and work calendars
text.description: The Time and Attendance system defines shifts and work calendars for employment types or individuals. Clock-in and clock-out data is received from the software or time clock devices and can be corrected. Calculating attendance factors at the daily and pay-period level prepares the data needed to review work time and calculate payroll.
benefits: Record and correct clock-in and clock-out data
Calculate daily and periodic attendance factors
Align work time data with payroll

text.name: Leave and Missions
text.cardText: Manage requests and approvals, and record leave taken and employee mission expenses.
text.tagline: Track leave and mission requests, authorizations, and records
text.description: The Leave and Missions system links leave rules and limits to requests, approvals, and authorizations. Recorded leave is reflected in work time calculations. Travel details and mission expenses are kept together with authorization and completion records, so the status of each request and its costs can be tracked.
benefits: Apply leave to work time calculations

text.name: Payroll
text.cardText: Calculate earnings and deductions, issue payslips, and produce payroll reports and accounting vouchers.
text.tagline: Calculate pay from orders and approved work time
text.description: The Payroll system uses attendance factors, orders, and one-time earnings and deductions to calculate pay for each period. Payslips, payment, insurance, and tax reports, and automatic accounting vouchers based on finalized payroll, keep payroll finance operations in sync. Effective dating of factors and comparative reports make it easier to review changes in pay.
benefits: Align calculations with orders and work time

text.name: Employee Self-Service
text.cardText: View permitted record information and submit and track leave, training, and welfare requests.
text.tagline: Employee access to personal information and requests
text.description: The Employee Self-Service system lets employees view permitted personnel record information and clock-in and clock-out data, and request corrections. Employees can submit and track requests for leave, missions, welfare benefits, product purchases, or training courses. Recording personnel events and taking part in tests and surveys make it easier for employees to engage with organizational services.
benefits: Direct access to permitted personal information
Fewer visits to correct attendance records
Access to training and welfare services

text.name: Recruitment
text.cardText: Record applicant resumes and history, and manage assessments and recruitment stages.
text.description: The Recruitment system records applicants' details, contact information, and work, education, and training history separately from employee records. Defining recruitment projects and processes, with one or more assessors, makes it possible to track each applicant's status through the hiring stages. Stored records and analytical reports help in reviewing applicants.
benefits: Track the status of each recruitment project

text.name: Employee Welfare
text.cardText: Plan the use of welfare benefits and facilities, and link installments to payslips.
text.tagline: Manage employee welfare facilities, loans, and repayments
text.description: The Employee Welfare system defines welfare resources and facilities and loan types, along with eligibility conditions, limits, and repayment terms. Employee requests are prioritized and allocated, and loan installments and related costs are recorded in connection with payroll and accounting. Usage and repayment reports show each person's benefit history.
benefits: Link repayments to payroll and accounting

text.name: Training
text.cardText: Define courses and prerequisites, schedule classes, record attendance, run exams, and issue certificates.
text.tagline: Plan courses, classes, and employee training records
text.description: The Training system records courses, training packages, instructors, and venues along with their costs and required resources. Turning courses into classes, scheduling sessions, and recording employee attendance and exam results make training delivery traceable. Allocating monetary and hourly training credits and issuing completion certificates help manage training resources and records.
benefits: Keep training records and completion certificates

text.name: Performance Evaluation
text.cardText: Define questionnaires and scores, plan evaluations, and analyze results for employees and applicants.
text.tagline: Run evaluations based on criteria and questionnaires
text.description: The Performance Evaluation system defines criteria, response types, and question scores in questionnaires. Individual and group programs can include multiple questionnaires and evaluators, and can be run for employees, job applicants, or instructors. Periodic, training, and 360-degree evaluations, along with results reporting, support performance review.
